tempo.basis: from 3 complete recordings, median 1:18 (Raúl Hernández/Olaf Laneri 1:26, María Bayo/Juan Antonio Álvarez Parejo 1:18, Carmen Artaza/Hilko Dumno 1:17), 1.5 s allowed for silence (recordings around 2:35 that sing the song twice were left out); Obradors marks it Andantino

notes: Anonymous words (a Spanish popular copla), set by Obradors in his Canciones clásicas españolas, vol. 1 (1921). IPA follows Castilian Spanish as sung in art song (θ for c/z, ʎ for ll, tap ɾ and trill r, soft β ð between vowels), stress marked. Literal translation, for meaning.
